description: Formal versioned rule catalog for pre-packaged commodities statutory declarations under Chapter II of PCR 2011.

rules.title: Declaration of Name and Address of Manufacturer, Packer, or Importer
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 6(1)(a) read with Explanations I, II, and III
rules.applicability: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale under Chapter II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
exemptions: Packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kg or 25 litre (except cement, fertilizer, and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg) under Rule 3(a)-(b)
Packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers under Rule 3(c)
Packages containing food articles, where requirements of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (FSSA) and rules thereunder apply instead pursuant to Rule 6(1)(a) Explanation III
rules.expected_condition: Both name and complete address of the manufacturer (or manufacturer and packer, or importer for imported packages) must be declared conspicuously on the package or label.
rules.evidence_requirement: OCR bounding box and extracted text string containing entity name and physical street/locality/city/state address.

rules.title: Declaration of Country of Origin for Imported Products
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 6(1)(aa)
rules.applicability: Imported pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale under Chapter II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
exemptions: Domestic (non-imported) pre-packaged products manufactured in India
Rule 3 general exemptions (packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L and industrial/institutional consumers)
rules.expected_condition: For imported packages, the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly must be declared on the package or label.
rules.evidence_requirement: OCR bounding box and text matching 'Country of Origin', 'Made in', or a recognized sovereign country name when product/inspection is flagged as imported.

rules.title: Declaration of Common or Generic Name of the Commodity
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 6(1)(b)
rules.applicability: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale under Chapter II, including combination packages containing more than one product.
exemptions: Rule 3 general exemptions (packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L and industrial/institutional consumers)
rules.expected_condition: The common or generic name of the commodity must be declared on the package; in case of packages with more than one product, the name and quantity of each product must be declared.
rules.evidence_requirement: OCR bounding box and text line identifying the generic or common commodity denomination on the package.

rules.title: Declaration of Net Quantity in Standard Units of Weight, Measure, or Number
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 6(1)(c) read with Rule 11, Rule 12, and Fourth Schedule
rules.applicability: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale under Chapter II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
exemptions: Rule 3 general exemptions (packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L and industrial/institutional consumers)
Exceptions specified under Rule 12(2) and Fourth Schedule for specific commodity categories
rules.expected_condition: Net quantity must be declared with a positive numeric quantity and an approved standard statutory metric unit (g, kg, ml, l, m, cm) or count (number, N, U, pieces).
rules.evidence_requirement: OCR bounding box and text string containing numeric quantity and recognized standard metric unit of weight, volume, length, or unit count.

rules.title: Declaration of Month and Year of Manufacture
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 6(1)(d) read with Provisos, G.S.R. 779(E), and G.S.R. 226(E)
rules.applicability: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale under Chapter II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
exemptions: Food articles governed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
Seeds labeled and certified under the Seeds Act, 1966
Cosmetics products governed under the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945
Packages containing bidi or incense sticks (agarbatti) under Rule 6(1) Proviso (A)(i)
Domestic LPG cylinders of 14.2 kg or 5 kg bottled and marketed by PSUs under Rule 6(1) Proviso (A)(ii)
Rule 3 general exemptions (packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L and industrial/institutional consumers)
rules.expected_condition: The month and year of manufacture must be declared on the package in words, numerals, or both (e.g., MM/YYYY, MM-YYYY, or MMM YYYY).
rules.evidence_requirement: OCR bounding box and date text string parsing into a valid calendar month and 4-digit calendar year.

rules.title: Declaration of Best Before or Use By Date for Perishable Commodities
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 6(1)(da)
rules.applicability: Packages containing a commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time.
exemptions: Commodities where expiry or best-before provisions are made in any other law (such as food under FSSA or pharmaceuticals under D&C Rules)
Non-perishable, durable, or non-consumable pre-packaged goods
Rule 3 general exemptions (packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L and industrial/institutional consumers)
rules.expected_condition: If the commodity is perishable and not exempt by other legislation, the 'best before' or 'use by' date, month, and year must be declared on the label.
rules.evidence_requirement: OCR bounding box and text containing 'Best Before' or 'Use By' followed by day/month/year or month/year string. Non-executable for automatic failure because commodity perishability and governing statute cannot be ascertained from label photograph alone.

rules.title: Declaration of Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Inclusive of All Taxes
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 6(1)(e) read with Rule 2(m), Proviso (C), and G.S.R. 226(E)
rules.applicability: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale under Chapter II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
exemptions: Packages containing bidi under Rule 6(1) Proviso (C)(i)
Domestic LPG cylinders covered under the Administrative Price Mechanism of the Government under Rule 6(1) Proviso (C)(ii)
Alcoholic beverages or spirituous liquor where State Excise Laws govern retail sale price declaration
Essential commodities whose retail sale price is fixed and notified under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955
Rule 3 general exemptions (packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L and industrial/institutional consumers)
rules.expected_condition: The retail sale price must be declared in Indian currency with explicit indication that it is the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes.
rules.evidence_requirement: OCR bounding box and text string containing numeric price value, currency symbol ('₹' / 'Rs.' / 'INR'), and tax inclusiveness phrase ('inclusive of all taxes' / 'incl. of all taxes').

rules.title: Principal Display Panel Grouping and Minimum Font Height Specifications
rules.legal_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Chapter II, Rule 7 read with Rule 2(h) and Table-I
rules.applicability: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale under Chapter II of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
exemptions: Rule 7(4): Sub-rules (1) to (3) do not apply if information is specified under any other law
Packages of capacity 10 cubic centimeters or less may use a card or firmly affixed tape under Rule 7(1)
Rule 3 general exemptions (packages containing quantity > 25 kg/L and industrial/institutional consumers)
rules.expected_condition: Mandatory declarations must be grouped together on the principal display panel, and numeral/letter heights must meet statutory minimums under Table-I based on the calculated area of the principal display panel.
rules.evidence_requirement: Multi-region layout grouping bounding boxes and calibrated millimeter measurements from image pixels. Non-executable for automated pass/fail because uncalibrated 2D photographs lack absolute scale/DPI calibration and container surface geometry.
